notes: every digitisation input is data, not code

wash_red_rule: R>100 and R-G>30 and R-B>18 and G<185
wash_yellow_rule: R-B>45 and G-B>35 and R>150 and G>140
uncertainty_rule: p95 of the residuals at every point the fit never saw (MODEL_SELECTION_HOLDOUT + BLIND_VALIDATION)
notes: closing_px is the DILATION used to seal the dashed wash network, in full-resolution pixels; it fattens the bands and the fattening is undone in two recorded places, never silently. Merge radius 13.0 km, coastal reach 20 km. Cells are read at half resolution.
